transcript.text: Back in 2025 I was in Shanghai for work and I remember just scrolling through rental car options there to kill time.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Funny thing is, on that same trip I kept comparing it to Beijing, because earlier I’d also been checking what parking was like around Beijing.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My coworker told me he ended up with a Toyota Corolla under the name John Smith, but it was all already handled before I even saw the details.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And yeah, that Corolla pickup date was 2025-03-15, and he kept it for 4 days—he was complaining about the paperwork the whole time.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Later that spring he also mentioned he’d already set up parking at China World Trade Center Parking starting 2025-04-25 12:00 for 12 hours, plate 浙E34567, and the contact number on it was 13811223344.
